name: Shri Mayureshwar Bhakta Niwas (Chinchwad Devasthan Trust)
why_special: The Chinchwad Devasthan Trust's official pilgrim accommodation for Morgaon's Mayureshwar Ganpati (first temple of the Astavinayak yatra) — dormitory and family rooms at trust rates, vegetarian prasad meals. Book through Chinchwad Devasthan office.
